info.title: NOAA SWPC Planetary K Index
info.description: The US Space Weather Prediction Center's planetary K index feed — three days observed and three days forecast, in three-hour bins. Free, keyless, no account. The feed is GLOBAL: Kp is a planetary index, and whether an aurora is visible from a given place is Kp judged against that place's geomagnetic latitude, which is the caller's job.

get.summary: Planetary K index, observed and forecast, in three-hour bins
get.description: A JSON array of objects: `time_tag` (UTC), `kp` (0-9), `observed` (`observed`, `estimated` or `predicted`), and `noaa_scale` (the G-scale storm level, null when quiet). Kp 5 is a minor storm, 7 strong, 9 extreme.

200.description: Array of three-hourly Kp readings and forecasts.
